article.headline: Donovan Oday scores 37, hits go-ahead 3-pointer, and Troy defeats Nicholls 78-77
article.description: — Donovan Oday’s 37 points, including the go-ahead 3-pointer with 10 seconds left, led Troy over Nicholls 78-77 at the Pensacola Invitational on Sunday.
article.linkText: Donovan Oday scores 37, hits go-ahead 3-pointer, and Troy defeats Nicholls 78-77
article.story: PENSACOLA, Fla. -- — Donovan Oday’s 37 points, including the go-ahead 3-pointer with 10 seconds left, led Troy over Nicholls 78-77 at the Pensacola Invitational on Sunday. Oday had six rebounds for the Trojans (3-4). Kerrington Kiel shot 4 of 8 from the field and 6 for 10 from the line to add 15 points. AJ Dent Jr. finished with 21 points, nine rebounds and two steals for the Colonels (2-5). Doyel Cockrill III added 18 points and three steals for Nicholls State. Christian Winborne finished with 13 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
